# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs from the server's tools/list. Do not edit by hand. -->

The server exposes **30 tools** and **1 prompt**. Every tool returns a JSON document as text.
Invalid input or an impossible action (unknown `mapId`, a cell outside the grid, a chest on a wall)
comes back as a tool error whose message says how to fix the call.

Coordinates are grid cells: `x` is the column (0..width-1) and `y` the row (0..height-1).
On an isometric map, cell (0,0) is the top corner of the diamond; `x` grows toward the lower right
and `y` toward the lower left. See [map-format.md](map-format.md) for the layers and properties.

Tags: `read-only` never changes anything, `destructive` can delete or overwrite, `idempotent` is safe
to repeat, `network` calls an external service.

## Map lifecycle

### list_themes

`read-only`

Lists the available map themes (tile palettes): key, display name, description, the tile roles each theme provides, and whether its sprite PNGs are present locally (sprites.status: all, partial or none). Themes without sprites still produce valid maps; Tiled shows placeholders until the sprites exist.

No parameters.

### create_map

`writes map`

Creates an empty isometric (default) or orthogonal Tiled map in the given theme and returns its mapId, which every other tool needs. The map has three tile layers (ground, walls, decorations) and two object layers (objects, spawns). Maps live in server memory until saved with save_to_disk or exported with export_json; they are lost when the server restarts.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Display name of the map, e.g. 'Crypt under the abandoned chapel'. 1..120 chars |
| `width` | integer | yes | Width in cells (1 cell = 5 ft in tabletop terms). 4..64 |
| `height` | integer | yes | Height in cells. 4..64 |
| `theme` | `CRYPT`, `CASTLE`, `WEREWOLF_DEN`, `TAVERN_BLOOD_PRINCE`, `VILLAGE`, `HAUNTED_FOREST`, `MAUSOLEUM`, `BLOOD_TOMB`, `AQUATIC`, `GLACIAIRE`, `INONDE`, `VOLCAN`, `FORET`, `HIVER`, `PRINTEMPS`, `ETE`, `AUTOMNE`, `DESOLATION`, `FUTURISTE`, `ELECTRONIQUE` | yes | Theme key from list_themes, e.g. CRYPT |
| `orientation` | `isometric`, `orthogonal` | no | Defaults to isometric |

### list_maps

`read-only`

Lists the maps held in memory by this server session, with their summaries.

No parameters.

### describe_map

`read-only`

Returns a summary of one map: size, orientation, theme, tile counts per tile type, and number of objects and spawns.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | mapId returned by create_map |

### discard_map

`destructive` `idempotent`

Deletes a map from server memory. Irreversible unless it was saved or exported first.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | mapId returned by create_map |

## Painting tiles

### paint_tile

`idempotent`

Paints a single cell of a tile layer with a tile role. Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `layer` | `ground`, `walls`, `decorations` | yes | ground = floors, hazards and difficult terrain; walls = wall tiles drawn above the ground (a cell with a wall is impassable); decorations = props above the ground (obstacle_decor blocks movement, decoration_minor is walkable) |
| `x` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `y` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `role` | `walkable_floor`, `walkable_floor_alt`, `wall`, `wall_corner`, `difficult_terrain`, `hazard_primary`, `obstacle_decor`, `decoration_minor`, `door_closed`, `stairs` | yes | Tile role, resolved to a sprite by the map's theme |

### paint_rect

`idempotent`

Paints every cell of the rectangle between two opposite corners (inclusive) on one layer. Typical use: paint_rect on 'ground' with walkable_floor for a room's floor. Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `layer` | `ground`, `walls`, `decorations` | yes | ground = floors, hazards and difficult terrain; walls = wall tiles drawn above the ground (a cell with a wall is impassable); decorations = props above the ground (obstacle_decor blocks movement, decoration_minor is walkable) |
| `x1` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `y1` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `x2` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `y2` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `role` | `walkable_floor`, `walkable_floor_alt`, `wall`, `wall_corner`, `difficult_terrain`, `hazard_primary`, `obstacle_decor`, `decoration_minor`, `door_closed`, `stairs` | yes | Tile role, resolved to a sprite by the map's theme |

### paint_wall_border

`idempotent`

Paints walls on the outline of a rectangle (inclusive corners) on the 'walls' layer, to enclose a room quickly. Erase single wall cells afterwards (erase_tile layer=walls) to open doorways. Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `x1` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `y1` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `x2` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `y2` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |

### erase_tile

`destructive` `idempotent`

Clears one cell of a tile layer (for example to open a doorway in a wall). Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `layer` | `ground`, `walls`, `decorations` | yes | ground = floors, hazards and difficult terrain; walls = wall tiles drawn above the ground (a cell with a wall is impassable); decorations = props above the ground (obstacle_decor blocks movement, decoration_minor is walkable) |
| `x` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `y` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |

### get_tile_info

`read-only`

Returns the tile on one layer at (x, y): gid (0 = empty), role, tile type and sprite id, plus the object or spawn standing on that cell if any. Check layer=walls before placing objects: a wall sits on top of a walkable ground tile. Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `layer` | `ground`, `walls`, `decorations` | yes | ground = floors, hazards and difficult terrain; walls = wall tiles drawn above the ground (a cell with a wall is impassable); decorations = props above the ground (obstacle_decor blocks movement, decoration_minor is walkable) |
| `x` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `y` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |

## Rooms and corridors

### generate_room

`writes map`

Builds a rectangular room in one call: walkable floor, a wall border, and a doorway with a closed door for each exit. Options add a hazard tile in the centre and obstacle props in the four inner corners (only if the theme defines those roles). originX/originY is the room's top-left cell; the walls are part of the room's width and height. Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `originX` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `originY` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `width` | integer | yes | Outer width including walls. 3..40 |
| `height` | integer | yes | Outer height including walls. 3..40 |
| `exits` | array of { direction: `north`, `south`, `east`, `west`; offset: integer } | no | max 4 items |
| `hazardCenter` | boolean | no | Paint the theme's hazard_primary tile at the room centre |
| `obstacleCorners` | boolean | no | Paint obstacle_decor props in the four inner corners |

### generate_corridor

`writes map`

Draws a straight, axis-aligned corridor between (fromX,fromY) and (toX,toY): walkable floor plus side walls. Interior width defaults to 1 (3 cells including both walls). Side walls that cross an existing room are painted too, so connect corridors to doorways. Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `fromX` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `fromY` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `toX` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `toY` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `width` | integer | no | Interior width in cells (default 1). 1..4 |

## Layout presets

### generate_crypt_layout

`writes map`

Fills a map with a crypt: entrance hall (west), central nave, north and south burial chambers, and a deep crypt (east) with a hazard tile and corner obstacles, all connected by doors and corridors. Needs a map of at least 27x18. Suited to the CRYPT, BLOOD_TOMB and MAUSOLEUM themes. Adds a player spawn in the entrance unless addPlayerSpawn is false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `addPlayerSpawn` | boolean | no | Place a player spawn in the entrance (default true) |

### generate_castle_floor

`writes map`

Fills a map with a castle floor: antechamber (west) behind a locked main door (pick DC 18), a great hall, north and south wings, and a far room (east) whose content depends on floorVariant. The 'throne' variant adds a throne prop and an enemy 'Castle lord' spawn. Needs a map of at least 27x20. Suited to the CASTLE theme.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `floorVariant` | `entrance`, `throne`, `private_chambers` | no | entrance = inner courtyard, throne = throne room (default), private_chambers = private apartments |
| `addPlayerSpawn` | boolean | no | Place a player spawn in the antechamber (default true) |

### generate_werewolf_den

`writes map`

Fills a map with a cave den: cave mouth (west), hunting hall with bone obstacles, a nest of young wolves (north), a bone store (south) and the alpha's lair (east) with a hazard tile. Adds enemy spawns 'Alpha werewolf' and 'Werewolf cub'. Needs a map of at least 22x16. Suited to the WEREWOLF_DEN theme.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `addPlayerSpawn` | boolean | no | Place a player spawn at the cave mouth (default true) |

## Objects

### place_door

`writes map`

Adds a door to the 'objects' layer. Put doors in a wall opening: erase the wall at that cell first (erase_tile layer=walls) and keep a ground tile under it; generate_room does this for its exits. A locked door needs pickDC to be picked open. Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `x` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `y` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `locked` | boolean | no | Defaults to false (closed but unlocked) |
| `pickDC` | integer | no | Difficulty class to pick the lock (5..30). 5..30 |
| `targetZoneId` | string | no | Optional id of the zone this door leads to (for multi-zone dungeons) |
| `name` | string | no |  |

### place_chest

`writes map`

Adds a chest to the 'objects' layer. A locked chest needs pickDC to be opened. The cell must be painted ground without a wall and without another object or spawn; otherwise the call fails with an explanation. Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `x` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `y` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `locked` | boolean | no |  |
| `pickDC` | integer | no | Difficulty class to pick the lock (5..30). 5..30 |
| `name` | string | no |  |

### place_stairs_object

`writes map`

Adds a stairs object that moves the party to another zone (targetZoneId). Unlike the decorative 'stairs' tile role, this object carries the zone link. The cell must be painted ground without a wall and without another object or spawn; otherwise the call fails with an explanation. Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `x` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `y` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `targetZoneId` | string | yes | Id of the destination zone |
| `name` | string | no |  |

### place_trap

`writes map`

Adds a trap to the 'objects' layer. Entering the cell triggers a saving throw when trapSaveDC is set, otherwise the damage applies automatically. The cell must be painted ground without a wall and without another object or spawn; otherwise the call fails with an explanation. Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `x` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `y` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `trapType` | string | yes | Damage type, e.g. piercing, fire, poison, lightning |
| `trapNotation` | string | yes | Damage dice, e.g. 2d6 or 3d4+1. pattern `^\d+[dD]\d+([+-]\d+)?$` |
| `trapSaveDC` | integer | no | Saving throw difficulty class (5..30). 5..30 |
| `name` | string | no |  |

### place_lever

`writes map`

Adds a lever players can pull. Its effect is up to the game engine that loads the map. The cell must be painted ground without a wall and without another object or spawn; otherwise the call fails with an explanation. Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `x` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `y` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `name` | string | no |  |

## Spawns

### place_spawn_player

`writes map`

Adds a player start point to the 'spawns' layer. Every playable map needs at least one (validate_map warns otherwise). The cell must be painted ground without a wall and without another object or spawn; otherwise the call fails with an explanation. Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `x` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `y` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `name` | string | no |  |

### place_spawn_enemy

`writes map`

Adds an enemy spawn point to the 'spawns' layer. encounterId links it to an encounter defined by the game engine; npcName is the creature's display name. The cell must be painted ground without a wall and without another object or spawn; otherwise the call fails with an explanation. Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `x` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `y` | integer | yes | 0..9007199254740991 |
| `encounterId` | string | no | Id of an existing encounter in the game engine |
| `npcName` | string | no | Display name, e.g. 'Alpha werewolf' |
| `name` | string | no |  |

### place_spawn_npc

`writes map`

Adds a non-hostile NPC spawn point (merchant, quest giver, ally) to the 'spawns' layer. The cell must be painted ground without a wall and without another object or spawn; otherwise the call fails with an explanation. Coordinates are grid cells: x is the column (0..width-1), y is the row (0..height-1), (0,0) is the top corner of an isometric map (top-left of an orthogonal one).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|

| `name` | string | no |  |

## Validation and export

### validate_map

`read-only`

Checks the map before export: Tiled structure (errors) and gameplay sanity (warnings): at least one player spawn, no object or spawn on a wall or outside the painted ground, no door left inside a wall. Returns { ok, errors, warnings }.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |

### export_json

`read-only`

Returns the full Tiled JSON (.tmj content) of a map as text. Sprite paths are written as './assets/<theme>/<role>.png' relative to the repository root; use save_to_disk to get a file whose sprite paths resolve from where it is saved.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |

### save_to_disk

`destructive` `idempotent`

Writes the map to a .tmj file that opens directly in the Tiled editor. A relative path is resolved against the maps folder (the repository's maps/ by default, or TILED_MAPS_DIR); an absolute path is used as is. Missing folders are created and an existing file is overwritten. Sprite paths inside the file are rewritten relative to its location so Tiled finds the PNGs.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `path` | string | yes | File path ending in .tmj or .json, e.g. 'crypt-chapel.tmj' (goes to the maps folder) or an absolute path. min 1 chars |

## Sprites (optional, generation is paid)

### preview_sprite_prompt

`read-only`

Free: returns the exact FLUX prompt, geometry and size generate_tile_sprite would use for (theme, role) with optional overrides, without calling any service. Use it to iterate on wording before paying for a generation.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `theme` | `CRYPT`, `CASTLE`, `WEREWOLF_DEN`, `TAVERN_BLOOD_PRINCE`, `VILLAGE`, `HAUNTED_FOREST`, `MAUSOLEUM`, `BLOOD_TOMB`, `AQUATIC`, `GLACIAIRE`, `INONDE`, `VOLCAN`, `FORET`, `HIVER`, `PRINTEMPS`, `ETE`, `AUTOMNE`, `DESOLATION`, `FUTURISTE`, `ELECTRONIQUE` | yes | Theme key from list_themes |
| `role` | `walkable_floor`, `walkable_floor_alt`, `wall`, `wall_corner`, `difficult_terrain`, `hazard_primary`, `obstacle_decor`, `decoration_minor`, `door_closed`, `stairs` | yes | Tile role, e.g. walkable_floor, wall, obstacle_decor |
| `material` | string | no |  |
| `lighting` | string | no |  |
| `extraDetail` | string | no |  |

### generate_tile_sprite

`network`

PAID: generates one isometric sprite for (theme, role) with FLUX.1-dev via Hugging Face Inference Providers, removes the magenta background and resizes it to 64x32 (floors) or 64x64 (walls, props). Saves <assets>/<theme>/<role>.png, or <role>__<variant>.png when variant is set. Takes 20-40 s and costs money per call; check that the file is missing first (list_themes shows missing sprites) and preview the prompt with preview_sprite_prompt. An existing file is kept unless force is true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `theme` | `CRYPT`, `CASTLE`, `WEREWOLF_DEN`, `TAVERN_BLOOD_PRINCE`, `VILLAGE`, `HAUNTED_FOREST`, `MAUSOLEUM`, `BLOOD_TOMB`, `AQUATIC`, `GLACIAIRE`, `INONDE`, `VOLCAN`, `FORET`, `HIVER`, `PRINTEMPS`, `ETE`, `AUTOMNE`, `DESOLATION`, `FUTURISTE`, `ELECTRONIQUE` | yes | Theme key from list_themes |
| `role` | `walkable_floor`, `walkable_floor_alt`, `wall`, `wall_corner`, `difficult_terrain`, `hazard_primary`, `obstacle_decor`, `decoration_minor`, `door_closed`, `stairs` | yes | Tile role, e.g. walkable_floor, wall, obstacle_decor |
| `variant` | string | no | Contextual variant slug, e.g. 'alembic' for a laboratory: saved as <role>__<variant>.png and bound to a map with override_tile_image. pattern `^[a-z0-9_]+$` |
| `material` | string | no | Override of the material description, e.g. 'alchemical workbench with brass alembics' |
| `lighting` | string | no | Override of the lighting description |
| `extraDetail` | string | no | Free text appended to the prompt |
| `seed` | integer | no | Seed for reproducibility. -9007199254740991..9007199254740991 |
| `force` | boolean | no | Regenerate even if the file already exists (paid again) |
| `outputDir` | string | no | Output folder; relative paths resolve against the assets folder. Defaults to <assets>/<theme_lowercase>/ |

### generate_theme_sprite_set

`network`

PAID and slow: generates every sprite of a theme that is missing on disk (about 30 s and one paid call per sprite, typically 8-10 sprites, so 4-5 minutes). Existing sprites are skipped unless force is true. Many MCP clients time out on calls this long; for a whole theme prefer the command line script: node scripts/gen-theme-set.mjs <THEME> --yes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `theme` | `CRYPT`, `CASTLE`, `WEREWOLF_DEN`, `TAVERN_BLOOD_PRINCE`, `VILLAGE`, `HAUNTED_FOREST`, `MAUSOLEUM`, `BLOOD_TOMB`, `AQUATIC`, `GLACIAIRE`, `INONDE`, `VOLCAN`, `FORET`, `HIVER`, `PRINTEMPS`, `ETE`, `AUTOMNE`, `DESOLATION`, `FUTURISTE`, `ELECTRONIQUE` | yes | Theme key from list_themes |
| `force` | boolean | no | Regenerate sprites that already exist (paid again) |
| `seed` | integer | no | -9007199254740991..9007199254740991 |

### override_tile_image

`idempotent`

Points one role of a single map's tileset at a variant image, e.g. obstacle_decor__alembic.png instead of obstacle_decor.png. Only that map changes; other maps and the theme keep their defaults. Call after create_map and before saving or exporting.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `role` | `walkable_floor`, `walkable_floor_alt`, `wall`, `wall_corner`, `difficult_terrain`, `hazard_primary`, `obstacle_decor`, `decoration_minor`, `door_closed`, `stairs` | yes | Tile role, e.g. walkable_floor, wall, obstacle_decor |
| `variant` | string | yes | Variant slug: the file <assets>/<theme>/<role>__<variant>.png should exist. pattern `^[a-z0-9_]+$` |
| `imageWidth` | integer | no | Image width in pixels if it differs from the default. -9007199254740991..9007199254740991 |
| `imageHeight` | integer | no | Image height in pixels if it differs from the default. -9007199254740991..9007199254740991 |
| `customPath` | string | no | Use this image path verbatim instead of the './assets/<theme>/<role>__<variant>.png' convention |

## Prompts

### Prompt: map_builder

Loads the map-builder skill and applies it to your description of the map: theme, size, encounters, traps, output.

| Argument | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
